answer_1.quote: abstractive document summarization is the task of condensing a document into its shorter form with important content preserved...

answer_2.quote: We used ROUGE to measure the quality of different summarization model outputs.

answer_4.quote: we also evaluated abstractive systems by eliciting human judgements.
answer_4.guideline: They are asked to rank the outputs of these systems from best to worst according to informativeness (does the summary capture the informative part of the document?), fluency (is summary grammatical?), and succinctness (does the summary express the document clearly in a few words?)
